noah: Hey team, Catalyst Health wants a capability matrix + embedding perf numbers and a security Q for HSM/KMS. 48h turnaround. They also want pricing options for a 6-week pilot and an enterprise POC. RFI: <https://catalyst/reqs/rfi_0626.pdf>
tara: I can do the capmatrix. Want to push back on signal: they asked for p99 numbers as well which we typically don't publish publicly. Ask for permission to provide internal bench p99 under NDA?
noah: Good call. We'll offer p95 public, p99 available under NDA. Finance: any POC pricing guidance for 6-week?
finance: Typical 6-week pilot: $5k flat for hosted small-scale (upto 200k tokens), reserved POC options for Dedicated at $12k/month committed for 2 months with standard pilot discount 25% on first month. Note: include line about custom quotes.
devbot: Attached bench: https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/catalyst/embed-182999.csv and base capmatrix: https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/catalyst/capmatrix-template.pdf :white_check_mark:
tara: For KMS wording: "Redwood Private integrates with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), supports CloudHSM and on-prem HSMs via KMIP/PKCS#11, and retains no raw key material in Redwood-managed services." Add cert list (SOC2, ISO27001).
noah: Action items: Tara: capmatrix + note about p95/p99 (EOD), Finance: pricing blurb + POC options (EOD), Devops: confirm EU data residency wording (EOD). Will QA and hand to legal.
